items.prompt: Study the position. Black plays 30...Ra2+ and White answers 31.31.Rb2. Move nothing. Tap each Black piece that is loose (attacked and not defended) after those two moves. Tap the square the piece will then stand on.

claims.statement: Black's first move is legal.
After the two moves White's loose pieces are exactly: none.
After the two moves Black's loose pieces are exactly: a2.

hints: After each move, update three things: what moved, what left the board, what is attacked now.
Go slowly through the second move: which piece did it remove or uncover, and what did that piece attack or defend?
Look at the square a2 after the answer: which white piece attacks it, and does any black piece defend it?
items.explain: After 30...Ra2+ 31.Rb2, the black rook on a2 is attacked and not defended, so it is loose.
